items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Bill Graham in the context of Duke Ellington's band ('Duke thought he'd better get rid of him'). The interviewee (Butter Jackson) is narrating this event as a third party. There is no evidence in the text that Butter Jackson personally knew, met, or worked with Bill Graham.

ctx.x: Then Bill Graham. He was in there for a while. But Bill Graham, he had everybody drinking his wine, so Duke thought he'd better get rid of him.
